=== about
The eight patch modes with a selector, applied in order to one list.
=== page
<ul id="l"><li id="a">A</li><li id="b">B</li><li id="c">C</li></ul>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #b
data: elements <li id="b" class="x">B2</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #a
data: elements <i>A2</i>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #l
data: elements <li id="d">D</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode prepend
data: selector #l
data: elements <li id="z">Z</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode before
data: selector #c
data: elements <li id="y">Y</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode after
data: selector #c
data: elements <li id="x">X</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode replace
data: selector #d
data: elements <li id="w">W</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode remove
data: selector #z

=== dom
<ul id="l"><li id="a"><i>A2</i></li><li id="b" class="x">B2</li><li id="y">Y</li><li id="c">C</li><li id="x">X</li><li id="w">W</li></ul>
